plane_connector_model: Point-plane restriction onto plane unitary bases. Geometric boundary lines are not lifted to separate unknowns.

plane_blocks.connector_model: Minimal point-plane prototype: the plane generic basis carries the unknowns; geometric boundary lines are incidence geometry only and are not introduced as separate unknown-bearing manifolds.
plane_blocks.boundary_model_note: Because single_group_connectivity.json has line_plane = [] and all plane boundaries are geometric_only, the usable minimal connector is direct restriction from each boundary corner point to the common plane unitary-subgroup basis.
